dataIdInfo.idAbs: The WMTS to Tiles toolbox tools download tiles from a WMTS service and package them into an MBTiles or GeoPackage file suitable for offline use. Parameters are the same between the MBTiles and GeoPackage tools; only the output file type is different.
dataIdInfo.idPurp: Download WMTS map service tiles into MBTiles or GeoPackage files for offline use.
